checkpoints.description: [1/1] harden the client: parse CRLF SSE events, raise mid-stream error events, keep live conversation objects while sorting the sidebar, block new chats while streaming, and ignore IME Enter

impact_assessment.why: A review found edge cases that would silently drop answers or reorder the chat list incorrectly
impact_assessment.benefits: Interoperability with CRLF SSE servers, visible server errors, correct sidebar order while a reply streams
impact_assessment.risks: contract: client stream parsing and UI behavior; dependency: none; concurrency: one stream at a time; state: conversations stay in place
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for CRLF and error events, plus the existing end-to-end stream smoke

impact_assessment.why: The chat works, but users cannot copy a message, retry an answer, or read earlier text while a reply streams because every delta forces the view to the bottom
impact_assessment.benefits: Faster iteration on answers, usable long transcripts during streaming, and familiar chat affordances without new dependencies
impact_assessment.risks: contract: client UI behavior and assistant-message lifecycle; dependency: none; concurrency: one stream at a time; state: regenerating replaces the trailing assistant message in browser-local history
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit test for the regenerate helper, existing 22-test suite plus project check, and a headless smoke of the served page

[1/1] per-chat composer drafts: localStorage-backed unsent text per chat id, synchronous save on input, restore on select/create/delete/import/clear-all/init, clear on Send; no wire, render, streaming, thinking or key changes

impact_assessment.why: switching chats or reloading lost unsent composer text
impact_assessment.benefits: drafts survive reloads and chat switches with zero server impact
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new localStorage key and store API; dependency: none; concurrency: single composer, streaming guards block select/create/delete; state: drafts share localStorage quota
impact_assessment.mitigation: restore only at select/create/delete/import/clear-all/init call sites; 20k char cap; corrupt reads as empty; quota failure keeps live composer value; 3 new unit tests plus isolated-browser E2E

[1/1] settle stale streaming frame: cancel pending rAF in runTurn.finally plus idle guard in updateStreamingMessage; no API, wire, render, storage, or key changes

impact_assessment.why: a queued paint can fire after the final render, leaving thinking open and stats hidden until the next render
impact_assessment.benefits: every completed turn settles into final paint immediately with no interaction
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, same DOM functions; dependency: none; concurrency: single stream handle trusted by existing guards; state: none, no stored data
impact_assessment.mitigation: cancel is deterministic via microtask-before-paint ordering; guard falls back to full renderMessages; E2E over mock SSE proves 5 consecutive settles incl stop and error
